description:
The Defense Logistics Agency Energy (DLA Energy) will host an AIR Card® Information Session for POS teams / AIR Card® Processors ONLY. Upcoming changes on the AIR Card® Program will be discussed and POS teams / AIR Card® Processors will have the opportunity to provide feedback to DLA Energy and voice their concerns and questions about the new changes under the AIR Card® Program. 

When: April 13th, 2026, starting at 9:30AM EST to 11:30AM EST

Where: This will be a virtual event, credentials will be provided closer to the event. Registration is required

What: Topics to be discussed include: AIR Card® invoicing procedures, Fully Itemized Price and signed delivery ticket.

Who: AIR Card® POS teams and Processors ONLY
